label: Тёплый / Холодный
description: Oppositional adjective drill: тёплый vs холодный across gender, number, the comparatives теплее/холоднее, and impersonal тепло/холодно.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine agreement. 1. 'Тёплый' matches masculine 'день'. 2. The ending is the masculine -ый. 3. Note the ё is always written in the positive form.
Strategic focus: Masculine agreement. 1. 'Холодный' matches masculine 'ветер'. 2. The ending is the masculine -ый. 3. A clean masculine pair with no ё.
Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Тёплая' matches feminine 'вода'. 2. The ending is the feminine -ая. 3. The ё stays in the stem of the positive form.

missions.phrase: В этом году была холодная зима.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Холодная' matches feminine 'зима'. 2. The ending is the feminine -ая. 3. A clean feminine pair with no ё.
Strategic focus: Neuter agreement. 1. 'Тёплое' matches neuter 'море'. 2. The ending is the neuter -ое. 3. The ё is preserved in the positive form.
Strategic focus: Neuter agreement. 1. 'Холодное' matches neuter 'молоко'. 2. The ending is the neuter -ое. 3. A clean neuter pair with no ё.
Strategic focus: Plural agreement. 1. 'Тёплые' matches plural 'руки'. 2. The ending is the plural -ые. 3. Plural is gender-neutral, and the ё stays.
Strategic focus: Plural agreement. 1. 'Холодные' matches plural 'ночи'. 2. The ending is the plural -ые. 3. A clean plural pair, gender-neutral.

missions.phrase: К полудню на улице стало теплее.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Comparative form. 1. 'Теплее' is the comparative of тёплый. 2. The comparative loses the ё: write е, not ё. 3. 'Стало' marks the change of state.
Strategic focus: Impersonal weather. 1. 'Холодно' is the impersonal adverbial form. 2. It describes ambient cold, with no noun to agree with. 3. Contrast тепло for warmth.
